offline_generator: Extractive answers and deterministic threat-pattern matching; no pretrained LLM
embedding: Stable signed token-hash vectors, 384 dimensions; lexical, not learned semantic embeddings
retrieval: BM25 lexical ranking + hashed vector cosine; project-local corpus

llm_optional.version: Not downloaded or validated in build environment. Run model_probe.py to record digest and runtime version.
llm_optional.license_notice: Review the model-specific license before use or redistribution; weights are not bundled.

network: Offline mode has no runtime network dependency. Initial package/container/model installation requires internet unless pre-cached.

ai_assessment.fallback: None; errors are saved as Failed
ai_assessment.validation: Pydantic schema, asset references, unique IDs, citation membership, system-input citation requirement
ai_assessment.live_model_evaluation: Pending local runtime; fixture tests do not measure model quality
